Distances.definition: Distance from city i to city j

objective.description: "Minimize the total travel distance required to visit all N towns exactly once and return to the start city"

constraints.description: For each city i, the sum of outgoing routes equals 1 and the sum of incoming routes equals 1 (each city is entered and left exactly once)
Subtour elimination constraints must be satisfied to prevent the formation of disconnected cycles
Decision variables indicating whether a route between city i and city j is taken must be binary (0 or 1)
No route from a city to itself is allowed (x_{i,i} = 0 for all cities i)
